tokens.name: brand-orange
tokens.usage: UdEkoM orange (Figma MainUdeKom). Fill of primary buttons, the circular CTA, selected tabs and checked controls; accents and dots. Never the colour of text, an icon or a control border on a light ground (2.80:1 on white): use brand-orange-strong there. Labels on it use on-brand.

tokens.name: brand-orange-hover
tokens.usage: Hover, pressed and disabled fill of orange buttons (Figma MainHover).

tokens.name: brand-orange-halo
tokens.usage: 4px ring around orange buttons at rest, hover and disabled.

tokens.name: brand-orange-halo-strong
tokens.usage: 4px ring around orange buttons while pressed.

tokens.name: brand-orange-strong
tokens.usage: Added in version 2 (WCAG AA). Orange for text, icons, checked borders and the switch track: 5.38:1 on surface-1, 5.20 on background-2, 4.71 on background. On surface-2 it reaches 4.05:1 only, so no small orange text on the blush ground.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Added in version 2 (WCAG AA). Labels and glyphs on brand-orange (6.30:1) and on brand-orange-hover (5.16:1). White on the orange is 2.80:1 and is no longer used.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Main text and dark buttons (Figma MainBlack, ButtonBlack, TextPrimary on light pages).

tokens.name: ink-hover
tokens.usage: Hover, pressed and disabled fill of dark buttons (Figma ButtonHover).

tokens.name: ink-halo
tokens.usage: 4px ring around dark buttons at rest.

tokens.name: ink-halo-strong
tokens.usage: 4px ring around dark buttons while pressed.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary and muted text: intro lines, descriptions, placeholders, field notes, table headers (6.45:1 on surface-1, 5.64 on background).

tokens.name: text-on-dark
tokens.usage: Text on dark buttons and on background-dark sections (Figma TextPrimary in dark frames).

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Cards, the form card, inputs; text on dark and danger buttons.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Blush surface for soft panels and tinted cards.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Warm page background (most pages, forms).

tokens.name: background-2
tokens.usage: Cool alternate section background (Mission, Conferences).

tokens.name: background-dark
tokens.usage: Dark sections: events slider, footer.

tokens.name: neutral-100
tokens.usage: Tag chips in multiselect, quiet fills.

tokens.name: neutral-300
tokens.usage: Hairlines, disabled input fill, dividers.

tokens.name: neutral-400
tokens.usage: Same value as neutral-500 in the Figma file; kept so names match.

tokens.name: neutral-500
tokens.usage: Decorative only since version 2 (2.90:1 on white): disabled text and dashed decoration. Placeholders, notes and muted text use text-secondary; icons and control borders use neutral-700.

tokens.name: neutral-700
tokens.usage: Borders of every control (inputs, checkbox, radio, scale, search, dropzone) and icons inside controls: 4.05:1 on surface-1, 3.54 on background. Not for text.

tokens.name: neutral-900
tokens.usage: Control labels and input text (checkbox label, filled input).

tokens.name: neutral-950
tokens.usage: Field labels in the input kit (Inter Bold 14). The Figma input kit calls this Neutral/900; the rest of the file uses #2f3236 under that name.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Kept for the Figma name; not used by the components since version 2 (1.48:1 on white). Control borders use neutral-700.

tokens.name: text-field
tokens.usage: Text colour variable used in the application form fields.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error border, error icon and error message (Figma Semantic/Red 500).

tokens.name: danger-strong
tokens.usage: Error text where #ee3a3a is too light (Semantic/Red 600).

tokens.name: danger-hover
tokens.usage: Added in version 2 (WCAG AA). Hover fill of the danger button: white on it is 7.00:1 (white on danger was 3.96).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success border and icon (Semantic/Green 500).

tokens.name: success-strong
tokens.usage: Success message text. Darkened in version 2 from #13873d (Semantic/Green 600), which gave 4.13:1 on success-surface; now 4.88:1 there and 4.76 on background.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring of inputs, selects, multiselects and, since version 2, of checkbox, radio, switch and scale (3px, with a 1px white inner ring).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Added for Confera; not in the Figma file. Backdrop behind dialogs, drawers and the mobile sidebar.

tokens.name: success-border
tokens.usage: Added for Confera; not in the Figma file. Success alert border.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Added for Confera; not in the Figma file. Warning text and icon (amber, kept apart from the brand orange).

tokens.name: warning-surface
tokens.usage: Added for Confera; not in the Figma file. Warning alert and badge background.

tokens.name: warning-border
tokens.usage: Added for Confera; not in the Figma file. Warning alert border.

tokens.name: info-strong
tokens.usage: Added for Confera; not in the Figma file. Info text and icon; darker than focus so 12px badge text passes 4.5:1.
